description: This file is a shell script for controlling a Git web interface server, supporting start, stop, and restart actions. It includes configuration for various web servers such as lighttpd, Apache, WEBrick, Mongoose, plackup, and Python HTTP server, to deploy gitweb with customizable options.

methods.name: resolve_full_httpd
methods.description: Resolving the full path to the specified HTTP daemon based on the configuration and system environment.

methods.name: start_httpd
methods.description: Starts the web server with the configured settings, including generating configuration files and server scripts.

methods.name: stop_httpd
methods.description: Stops the running web server by killing its process and removing PID files.

methods.name: httpd_is_ready
methods.description: Waits until the HTTP server is ready by checking socket connectivity on the specified port.

methods.name: webrick_conf
methods.description: Generates configuration files for the WEBrick Ruby server.

methods.name: lighttpd_conf
methods.description: Generates configuration files for the Lighttpd server.

methods.name: apache2_conf
methods.description: Generates configuration files for Apache2 server, including modules and directives.

methods.name: mongoose_conf
methods.description: Creates configuration for the Mongoose web server.

methods.name: plackup_conf
methods.description: Generates a standalone PSGI server script with embedded configuration for plackup.

methods.name: python_conf
methods.description: Creates a simple Python HTTP server script with CGI support.

methods.name: configure_httpd
methods.description: Selects and invokes the appropriate server configuration generation based on the specified httpd type.
